name: Prime Minister's Award for Yoga
benefit: The winners will be felicitated by means of a Trophy, Certificate and a Cash Award. The value of each Cash Award would be ₹ 25 lakh.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should have rich experience and a deep understanding of Yoga. 1. The applicant (individual category) must be at least 30 years of age. 1. The applicant should have a minimum of 10 years of service with an excellent track record in promoting and developing Yoga. **Note:** The applicant can apply or be nominated for only one category (Individual or Institutional) in a particular year.
